items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-01
items.q: Nick, I had met following bands around, and I think also at the New Orleans Jazz Club meetings, and he was a nice kind of a guy.

ctx.x: What about the kitty in those places?

Well, most places had a cigar box or a milk bottle or a can, I think quite frequently supplied by the band, sometimes marked kitty, sometimes just discreetly displayed on top of the piano or in front, and sometimes with a sign saying feed the kitty. And people tended to fairly regularly. I remember one particularly enjoyable occasion, which I think I got invited to kind of late and wound up, I believe, only Greenwood and I went. But the manager of the George Lewis band at the time was a fellow, an attorney named…
